    19	def paginate(items: Sequence[T], page: int, per_page: int) -> Page[T]:
    20	    """Return one page using the package's existing one-based page API."""
    21	    if page < 1:
    22	        raise ValueError("page must be >= 1")
    23	    if per_page < 1:
    24	        raise ValueError("per_page must be >= 1")
    25
    26	    source_items = list(items)
    27	    total_items = len(source_items)
    28	    total_pages = ceil(total_items / per_page) if total_items else 0
    29	    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    30	    end = start + per_page
    31	    return Page(
    32	        number=page,
    33	        per_page=per_page,
    34	        total_items=total_items,
    35	        total_pages=total_pages,
    36	        items=source_items[start:end],
    37	    )

    56	def paginate_cursor(items: Sequence[T], cursor: str | None = None, per_page: int = 20) -> CursorPage[T]:
    57	    """Return one page and a cursor pointing at the first item of the next."""
    58	    from .tokens import decode_offset, encode_offset
    59
    60	    if per_page < 1:
    61	        raise ValueError("per_page must be >= 1")
    62	    offset = decode_offset(cursor)
    63	    batch = list(items[offset:offset + per_page])
    64	    end = offset + len(batch)
    65	    next_cursor = encode_offset(end) if end < len(items) else None
    66	    return CursorPage(batch, next_cursor, next_cursor is not None)
